high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the account "narendramodi." The post features a group photo of a man standing with a group of individuals who appear to be athletes, as they are holding medals around their necks. The man standing in the center is dressed in traditional Indian attire, including a white dhoti and a grey vest, which suggests he might be a figure of authority or importance. The group consists of both men and women, some of whom are seated in wheelchairs, indicating that they may be para-athletes.
